texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]在秘密的获取了一些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种的遗骸并进行研究后发现，生活在[From.GetName]和[other_planet.GetName]上的异星物种其实有着共同的祖先，他们两个物种是在最近才分道扬镳的。通过扫描两个星球上的遗迹，[Root.GetName]船员得出结论，这两个物种都起源于[other_planet.GetName]，他们在那里发展成早期的太空时代文明，当他们把[From.GetName]作为移居地之后，社会内部发生了分歧，新行星和母星上的住民打起了星际核战。

战斗异常惨烈，两个星球都被毁的满目疮痍并进入了漫长的核冬天，两个星球的生产力发展因此而退化到了铜器时代。
texts.en:
Through the clandestine procurement of some of the [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has made an intriguing discovery. The aliens on [From.GetName] and [other_planet.GetName] are in fact recently diverged species with the same origin. By scanning the ruins left behind on both planets, the [Root.GetName] crew has concluded that both species originated on [other_planet.GetName], where they flourished into an early space age civilization. Some time after colonizing [From.GetName], their society fractured, and an interplanetary nuclear war broke out between the new colony and its home planet.

In the ensuing cataclysm, both planets were ravaged by fallout and the nuclear winter that followed on its heels, plunging their inhabitants back into the bronze age.

# 二重身 / Doppelgangers

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:1978-2065 (old_foes_system); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1150; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:4044-4092 (distar.130); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:501-517; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:4095 (distar.131)

## 如何开始 How it starts

《遥远繁星》专属星系 old_foes_system 有两颗核爆后的墓星（Pyorun 与 Czyrni），都住着前超光速原住民。第一次勘察其中一颗时，隐藏事件 distar.130（on_survey_planet，全局一次）在另一颗上放置此异常（3级）。

The Distant Stars system old_foes_system has two nuked tomb worlds (Pyorun and Czyrni), both with primitive natives. When either is surveyed for the first time, the hidden distar.130 (on_survey_planet, once per game) places this level-3 anomaly on the other one.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.131“世仇”：两颗星球上的原住民其实同源。他们在 [other_planet] 发展到早期太空时代并殖民另一颗星球，之后社会分裂，爆发行星际核战，双方都被打回青铜时代。奖励社会学研究。

distar.131 "Old Foes": the two native species share one origin. They reached the early space age on one world, colonised the other, then fractured into an interplanetary nuclear war that bombed both back to the bronze age. Rewards society research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.
